audit.sample_scope: 15 most recent public videos from YouTube RSS
observations: Recent sample still shows meaningful residual reach despite inconsistent posting and mixed topics.
Median recent views around 2261 is material relative to the reported 7000 subscribers.
One recent video reached 19282 views, proving the channel can still exceed its subscriber base when topic/format resonates.
Performance variance is very high, so the channel should not be hard-rebranded before controlled experiments.
Recent titles indicate mixed lifestyle, food, animals, nostalgia, local places, and curiosity-style content rather than one tightly locked niche.

next_experiment.rule: Do not delete old videos. Publish a small coherent batch, measure response, then decide whether to rebrand further.
next_experiment.candidate_direction: AI-enhanced visual entertainment/storytelling that remains broad enough to fit the channel history.
